title: Ethereal Springy Slovakian Celeriac Braised
description: A garlicky, spring-inspired brunch-mood Slovakian dish featuring celeriac and a variety of herbs and spices. This plant-based-friendly recipe is perfect for a delicious and satisfying meal.
instructions: Peel and chop the celery root into 1-inch pieces.
Mince the garlic and onion, and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the chopped celery root, caraway seeds, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan.
Pour in enough water to cover the celery root and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the celery root is tender.
Stir in chopped parsley and dill, if using.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
